name: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited
summary: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited is a Canadian company specializing in the acquisition, exploration, and development of gold deposits. Its current holdings include an option agreement for a 100% interest in the High Lake mineral property, positioned east of the Ontario-Manitoba border. The company also maintains interests in the West Hawk Lake mineral property in Southwestern Manitoba, the McMillan and Mongowin properties in Northeastern Ontario, and the Michaud/Munro properties near Matheson, Ontario. McFarlane Lake Mining Limited operates from its head office in Sudbury, Canada.
